products.title: Hawas Kobra – Eau de Parfum for Men, 100 ml
products.short_description: A fresh, spicy and aquatic men's fragrance with a deep woody base.
products.description:
Hawas Kobra by Rasasi is a bold, modern fragrance for men. It opens fresh and fruity with bergamot and apple, warms up with cinnamon and cardamom, and settles into a long, woody base of ambergris, musk and patchouli.

**Size:** 100 ml

**Concentration:** Eau de Parfum

**Best for:** daily wear, office and evenings out.

details.title: How to use
details.body: Spray on pulse points – wrists, neck and behind the ears – from about 15 cm away. Do not rub. Store away from sunlight and heat.

details.title: Shipping and returns
details.body: Express shipping across India. Easy replacement if the product arrives damaged or incorrect.
